general.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG, up to 1 MB. Simulated: only the file name is kept — nothing is uploaded.
general.noLogo: No logo (the portal shows the DataHub HR mark).
general.currencyHint: Payroll supports these currencies per run; reports use the default and never mix currencies.

localization.languagesValue: English and العربية are both always available (Arabic right-to-left). Each user's own choice is kept.
localization.previewNote: Organisation defaults for exports, printed documents and the future backend's messages. Screens keep showing dates in each user's language.

calendar.workingWeekHint: New shifts start with these days. Existing shifts, attendance records and leave requests keep theirs.
calendar.holidaysHint: Leave Management counts leave days with this calendar (for leave types that exclude public holidays). Requests already made keep the days counted when they were made.
calendar.attendanceNote: Attendance follows each employee's shift schedule and does not skip public holidays; use shifts for working-day changes.
calendar.name: Holiday
calendar.deactivateBody: "{{name}}" will no longer be excluded from new leave requests. Existing requests are not changed.
calendar.activateBody: "{{name}}" will be excluded from new leave requests again.

attendance.intro: Attendance statuses are calculated from each shift and the check-in/out times every time they are shown, so these rules are fixed here: changing them would silently rewrite past records. Grace period, working time and working days are set per shift.

rule.scheduled: Not started — the shift has not ended and there is no check-in yet. It never becomes "absent" while the day is not over.
rule.absent: Absent — the shift ended without a check-in (approved leave days are "on leave" instead).
rule.late: Late — checked in after the shift start plus its grace period; minutes late count from the start.
rule.halfDay: Half day — worked less than half of the shift's working time.
rule.incomplete: Incomplete — checked in, but no check-out 4 hours after the shift ended.
rule.overtime: Overtime — not calculated: attendance records have no overtime field (payroll pays none).

attendance.punchRules: One check-in and one check-out per day; a check-out after the check-in; no future times and none far from the shift (simulated punches).

leave.intro: Leave types are configured in Leave Management. Values are configurable EXAMPLES, not a legal entitlement.
leave.leaveYearValue: Calendar year (1 January – 31 December); one request stays within one year.
leave.notSupportedValue: Monthly accrual and carry-forward of unused days (allocations are yearly, with seniority days and first-year pro-rating).
leave.routingValue: The employee's department manager (hr.leave.approve.team) or HR (hr.leave.approve); never one's own request.

recruitment.intro: Stages, sources and interview types are fixed by the pipeline rules (valid stage changes, history, reports). They are shown here for reference; requisitions and offers are managed in Recruitment.
recruitment.requisitionsValue: Draft → pending approval → open ⇄ on hold → closed (reopen) or cancelled.
recruitment.offersValue: Draft → sent (simulated) → accepted, rejected or withdrawn; expire automatically. Salary within the requisition range; hiring only through an accepted offer.

performance.intro: Review cycles, templates, competencies and the rating scale are configured in Performance Management (hr.performance.config.manage).
performance.frequencyValue: Set per cycle (its working window and the period it reviews).
performance.workflowValue: Self-assessment → manager review → completed; drafts are never shown to the other party.
performance.goalsValue: Progress 0–100 %; "completed" means 100 %; final statuses are locked.

payroll.intro: Payroll configuration lives in Payroll Management. Finalised (approved or paid) runs never change when settings change.
payroll.roundingValue: Each line once, half-up, to the currency's minor unit
payroll.statutoryValue: Not configured: statutory types are illustrative and inactive by default. No legal payroll rule is provided.
payroll.approvalValue: Draft → calculated → pending approval → approved → paid (simulated); hr.payroll.approve, never by the run's creator.

documents.intro: Document categories, their file rules (types, size, files, expiry, confidentiality) and required documents are configured in Documents Management.
documents.fileRulesValue: Per category: PDF, JPG, PNG, DOC(X); size and number of files per category (simulated upload — nothing is stored).
documents.verificationValue: Pending review → verified or rejected (with a reason); editing key details returns a document to review.

notifications.notice: Configuration only: the portal has no notification delivery yet — no in-app inbox, and no e-mail or SMS provider is connected. The future backend will send notifications with these rules.

events.recruitment-stage: Candidate moved to a new stage

workflows.intro: Each module approves its own requests with its own rules and permissions. They are shown here in one place; approvers are the roles that hold the approval permission (see Users & roles). Changing a role's permissions never changes requests already decided.
workflows.pendingValue: Keep the rules they were submitted under; nothing is re-routed.
workflows.escalationValue: Not supported yet (reminders are configured under Notifications).

leave.title: Leave requests
leave.approvers: Department manager (team) or HR; never one's own request

payroll.title: Payroll runs
payroll.stages: Calculated → submitted → approved or rejected → paid
payroll.approvers: Holders of hr.payroll.approve, never the run's creator

offer.title: Job offers
offer.stages: Draft → sent → accepted, rejected, withdrawn or expired
offer.approvers: Recruitment writers; salary within the requisition range

document.title: Document verification
document.stages: Pending review → verified or rejected (reason required)

security.sessionHint: Sessions end when the backend sign-in token expires (set by the backend). This value is kept for the HR backend’s own session policy.
security.showExpiry: Show when the session ends in the user menu
security.ssoIntro: Staff sign in once in DataHub Portals; this portal has no sign-in of its own. Shown read-only — no secret, token or credential is stored or displayed.
security.handoffValue: Accepted for at most {{value}} minutes, once
security.storageValue: This browser tab only (ends when the tab closes)
security.signOutValue: Ends the central session; other open tabs follow
security.passwordsValue: Not managed here: no passwords reach this portal
security.mockNotice: Prototype sign-in: the hand-off token is unsigned and authorisation is simulated in the browser. The real backend must verify sign-ins and enforce permissions on every request.
security.systemOnly: Only a System Administrator can change these settings.

audit.intro: Every change to settings, user accounts and roles, with the previous and new value.
audit.dataIntro: Restore every settings section and the holiday calendar to the demo defaults. Nothing else is changed: no employee, attendance, leave, payroll or document record, and no user account. The reset is recorded in this log.
audit.resetAllBody: All settings sections and the holiday calendar return to the demo defaults. This cannot be undone (the audit log keeps the history).
audit.resetAllDone: Settings reset to the demo defaults.
